question: For each course, list its title, name of the building of the course location, duration (in terms of days), and a running average of the duration (in terms of days) using a window of two preceding and two following courses (partitioned by academic year and sorted by course start date).
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "courses_enriched" AS WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        so.term_code,
        so.subject_id AS course_id,
        so.subject_title AS course_title,
        so.section_id,
        so.is_master_section,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY so.term_code, so.subject_id 
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN so.is_master_section IN ('Y','Yes','1','T','True') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                     CASE WHEN so.is_lecture_section IN ('Y','Yes','1','T','True') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                     so.section_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM beaver."subject_offered" so
), dedup AS (
    SELECT term_code, course_id, course_title
    FROM base
    WHERE rn = 1
), iap_loc AS (
    SELECT term_code, subject_id AS course_id,
           NULLIF(TRIM(meet_place), '') AS building_name
    FROM beaver."subject_iap_schedule"
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(meet_place), '') IS NOT NULL
), joined AS (
    SELECT 
        d.course_id,
        d.course_title,
        at.academic_year,
        at.term_start_date AS start_date,
        at.term_end_date AS end_date,
        il.building_name
    FROM dedup d
    JOIN beaver."academic_terms" at
      ON at.term_code = d.term_code
    LEFT JOIN iap_loc il
      ON il.term_code = d.term_code AND il.course_id = d.course_id
)
SELECT 
    course_id,
    course_title,
    CAST(atxt.academic_year AS VARCHAR) AS academic_year,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    building_name
FROM joined atxt

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year,
        building_name,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        DATE_DIFF('day', start_date::DATE, end_date::DATE) + 1 AS duration_days
    FROM courses_enriched
    WHERE course_title IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND academic_year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    course_title AS title,
    building_name AS building,
    duration_days AS duration_days,
    AVG(duration_days) OVER (
        PARTITION BY academic_year
        ORDER BY start_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS running_avg_duration_days,
    academic_year,
    start_date
FROM base
ORDER BY academic_year, start_date
LIMIT 100

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year,
        -- Try multiple possible location columns if materializer provided them later; keep building_name fallback
        COALESCE(building_name, NULLIF(TRIM(meet_place), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(location), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(room_building), '')) AS building_name_coalesced,
        -- Robust date parsing: try DD-MON-YY first, else try ISO YYYY-MM-DD
        COALESCE(STRPTIME(start_date, '%d-%b-%y'), TRY_STRPTIME(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))::DATE AS start_dt_raw,
        COALESCE(STRPTIME(end_date, '%d-%b-%y'), TRY_STRPTIME(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))::DATE   AS end_dt_raw
    FROM courses_enriched
    WHERE course_title IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND academic_year IS NOT NULL
), century_fix AS (
    -- If year parsed as 19xx due to %y but actual should be 20xx, heuristics: if academic_year >= 2000 and parsed year < 1976 then add 100 years
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year,
        building_name_coalesced,
        CASE WHEN academic_year >= 2000 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_dt_raw) < 1976
             THEN (start_dt_raw + INTERVAL '100 years')::DATE ELSE start_dt_raw END AS start_dt,
        CASE WHEN academic_year >= 2000 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_dt_raw) < 1976
             THEN (end_dt_raw + INTERVAL '100 years')::DATE ELSE end_dt_raw END   AS end_dt
    FROM parsed
), base AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year,
        building_name_coalesced AS building_name,
        start_dt,
        end_dt,
        DATE_DIFF('day', start_dt, end_dt) + 1 AS duration_days
    FROM century_fix
    WHERE start_dt IS NOT NULL AND end_dt IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    course_title AS title,

    AVG(duration_days) OVER (

FROM base
ORDER BY academic_year, start_dt
LIMIT 100

# Join meet_place as proxy for building; cast building_name to text for trimming; parse dates; compute duration and running average
import pandas as pd

query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        c.course_id,
        c.course_title,
        CAST(c.academic_year AS BIGINT) AS academic_year_num,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(c.building_name AS VARCHAR)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(i.meet_place), '')) AS building,
        c.start_date,
        c.end_date
    FROM courses_enriched c
    LEFT JOIN iap_meetings i ON i.subject_id = c.course_id
    WHERE c.course_title IS NOT NULL AND c.start_date IS NOT NULL AND c.end_date IS NOT NULL AND c.academic_year IS NOT NULL
), parsed AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year_num,
        building,
        COALESCE(STRPTIME(start_date, '%d-%b-%y'), TRY_STRPTIME(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))::DATE AS start_dt_raw,
        COALESCE(STRPTIME(end_date, '%d-%b-%y'), TRY_STRPTIME(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))::DATE   AS end_dt_raw
    FROM joined
), century_fix AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year_num,
        building,
        CASE WHEN academic_year_num >= 2000 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_dt_raw) < 1976
             THEN (start_dt_raw + INTERVAL '100 years')::DATE ELSE start_dt_raw END AS start_dt,
        CASE WHEN academic_year_num >= 2000 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_dt_raw) < 1976
             THEN (end_dt_raw + INTERVAL '100 years')::DATE ELSE end_dt_raw END   AS end_dt
    FROM parsed
), base AS (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        course_title,
        academic_year_num AS academic_year,
        building,
        start_dt,
        end_dt,
        DATE_DIFF('day', start_dt, end_dt) + 1 AS duration_days
    FROM century_fix
    WHERE start_dt IS NOT NULL AND end_dt IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    course_title AS title,
    building,
    duration_days,
    AVG(duration_days) OVER (
        PARTITION BY academic_year
        ORDER BY start_dt
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS running_avg_duration_days,
    academic_year,
    start_dt AS start_date
FROM base
ORDER BY academic_year, start_dt
LIMIT 100
